description: Groups GraphiQL packages for GraphQL IDE functionality

packageRules.description: graphiql and @graphiql/plugin-explorer only depend on specific @graphiql/react/@graphiql/toolkit ranges, and consumers' embedded editor code often targets a specific major version's API directly. Without this, Renovate splits major from non-major updates within the group by default, so a non-major bump of one package (e.g. @graphiql/react) can ship on its own branch while a major bump of another (e.g. graphiql itself) sits gated elsewhere (e.g. behind dependencyDashboardApproval) - installing incompatible versions side by side. separateMajorMinor: false keeps the whole group on one branch so that can't happen.
